card.name: Palaces and grand buildings in history
card.fires_on: Small words such as "in", "of", "from" or "to" right after a palace, harem or castle in architecture and history writing. Also fires on odd word pieces in the same setting.

modes.label: Link word after palace
modes.description: A small linking word follows a palace or castle name, leading to a place.
modes.example: A palace<< in>> the Via Giulia built for himself still

modes.label: Partway through words
modes.description: A word piece or digit inside a place name or number in descriptions of famous buildings.
modes.example: More than 20,<<0>>00 tiles were made under the supervision

modes.label: Comparison or origin words
modes.description: Words like "what", "to" or "from" in remarks about a grand building's size or materials.
modes.example: It’s also quite small compared to<< what>> it could’ve been, given his wealth

card.plain: It lights up on small words in writing about old palaces and grand buildings, just before a place or detail.
